Definition: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
BiblicalUsage: Lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, says God in Eden, and Pharaoh's daughter came down to the river, and her maidens walked along by the river's side. The priest shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering, and every man shall set forward in his place by the standards.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the hand is the Bible's picture of power, reach and place: the hand that takes in Eden, the river's side that is its hand, the hand laid on the offering, the place each man stands in. I believe the hand of God is the same word grown large — what man's hand grasps, God's hand gives, and what man's hand lays down, God's hand lifts.
